message.content: LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. He was born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, and rose to prominence as a high school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School. LeBron was selected first overall in the 2003 NBA Draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers and has since played for the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers (again), and Los Angeles Lakers. He has won multiple NBA championships, earned numerous MVP awards, and is known for his versatility, athleticism, and basketball IQ. Off the court, he is also recognized for his philanthropy—particularly his I PROMISE School initiative—and his influence in entertainment and business ventures.
